title: Expiry handling with lead time
intent: Implement should_handle_today. An item should be marked handle_today if expiry_date minus category_lead_time_days is today or earlier. Already expired items must also be handled. Invalid dates must fail.
ai_generated_spec: Mark items as handle_today when they expire today.
critic_improved_spec: Mark items as handle_today when expiry_date minus category_lead_time_days is today or earlier. Already expired items must be handled. Invalid dates must return an error.
missing_requirements: Category lead time must be applied
Items that should have been handled earlier are still handle_today
Already expired items must be handled
Boundary condition uses today or earlier, not only exact equality
expected_naive_failure: The naive public spec can select an implementation that only checks whether expiry_date equals today.
expected_defense: The omission-aware critic spec should reject implementations that ignore lead time, expired items, and invalid dates.

public_spec_text.naive: Mark items as handle_today when they expire today.
